Además había una señora con sus buenos años que atendía sola a todo el mundo, una genia en todo sentido.

(Translated by Google)
I used Full's facilities, and honestly, they're just as good as any regular coffee shop. I appreciate that they have a full cup of coffee, unlike the tiny ones that are so common these days.

Plus, there was a lovely older woman serving everyone by herself—she was a real gem.
